# Third-Party Material

This folder separates imported code from your own sketch history.

Current layout:

- `reference/`
  - Upstream libraries, vendor examples, and external repos kept for dependency lookup or source reference.

Rule of thumb:

- If you did not author the project here, it belongs under `third_party/`.
- If one of your sketches depends on it, keep the dependency readable but out of the main project flow.
